# Vendored acarsdec

Prebuilt aarch64 binary for the ACARS page. Invoked as a subprocess
(never linked) because acarsdec is GPLv2-only while zDR is GPL-3.0.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Upstream | https://github.com/TLeconte/acarsdec |
| Binary | `vendor/acarsdec/acarsdec` (ARM aarch64) |
| Install path | `/usr/lib/zdr/acarsdec` |
| License | GPL-2.0-only (see `LICENSE.md`) |
